cond_0457.intro: We are looking for an Operations Research Scientist to join our team. The role sits within the Operations Research (OR) Group. The focus is on developing MIP, heuristic, and algorithmic solutions to industry-specific problems, along with solid implementation of those solutions. The person in this role will develop decision support systems, manage their implementation, and handle support and maintenance. They will define system scope, objectives, and requirements based on standards and guidance from architects and senior team members, and coordinate with other parts of the organization as needed. Interaction with internal customers is part of the role, primarily to identify business requirements and determine the best course of action.
cond_0457.responsibilities:
Coordinate with business, internal technical, and external technology vendor teams to define, design, and develop new business applications.
Provide technical direction to team members and track deliverables of the technical team.
Handle project management and planning, including risk mitigation and timeline assessment.
Develop contingency plans, analyze systems for efficiencies, and build test case scenarios.
Formulate mathematical models and apply optimization methods using or developing requisite software for strategic, tactical, and operational decision making, policy formulation, and related functions.
Build and implement optimization models in the railroad transportation industry using linear and mixed integer programming, meta-heuristics, and network flow algorithms.
Use computer programming skills and relational database systems to develop optimization applications.
Analyze and improve existing code on projects in development.
Provide analytics support to various company initiatives.
Collect data and perform simulation and/or statistical analysis to extrapolate alternate scenarios.
Deploy new OR tools and document usage for end users.
Convert OR tool prototypes into production.
Manage university and outside consultant projects.
cond_0457.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Master's degree with 3 or more years of experience in object-oriented programming in C#, C++, or Java at a research or industry implementation level; or PhD with 5 or more years of equivalent experience.
Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming in C#, Java, C++, and/or Python.
Knowledge of relational database systems (Oracle, SQL Server, writing SQL).
Knowledge of custom data structures and their implementation.
Knowledge of routing/network algorithms and their implementation.
Familiarity with optimization solvers such as Gurobi or CPLEX.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in the transportation industry.
Knowledge of Visual Studio, Eclipse, or a related Integrated Development Environment (IDE).
